piece.headline: NIKHIL BOOSTS THE BENCH AND THE LEAGUE TAKES NOTICE
piece.big_picture: Chandru is still top, but Aashiv has cut the gap to 8. Nikhil's Bench Boost week lifted him into the top 3. B.Fernandes captained 12 managers to 46 each, so the armband decided plenty of this gameweek.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Inesh and Naresh both captained Palmer instead of B.Fernandes. Palmer gave them 14 with the armband, against 46. That's a 32-point swing, and it hurt both of them badly.
piece.one_to_watch: Chandru leads Aashiv by 8, down from 15 before this week. If Aashiv keeps closing at that pace, the top spot could change hands.

winners.name: Sahil
winners.verdict: Fernandes as captain dragged him up 7 places. Good call. He's still deep in the Tin Pot zone, so the job isn't done.

losers.name: Naresh
losers.verdict: Took a 16-point hit to bring in Palmer, then made him captain. B.Fernandes was the armband to have.

losers.name: Rajiv
losers.verdict: Haaland did his bit as captain, but 17 points sat on the bench. Right armband, wrong XI.
